Generated 24 Oct 2026, 14:12 · by Aoife Doyle · 214 test cases
Verify that a batch can only be released after a second authorised user applies an electronic signature that is bound to the record.
Log in as a QA reviewer and open batch B-24-0817 in status Pending release.
The batch record opens read-only and the Release action is enabled.
Select Release and enter the reviewer username and password in the signature dialog.
The dialog records the signer name, date, time and meaning of the signature.
Repeat the release as the same user who created the batch record.
The system rejects the signature: creator and releaser must be different users.
Enter an incorrect password three times in a row.
The account is locked and a security event is written to the audit trail.
Open the audit trail for B-24-0817 and filter by signature events.
Each signature attempt appears with user, timestamp and outcome; entries cannot be edited.
Export the batch record to PDF.
The PDF shows the printed name, signature date and meaning for every signature.
The system shall require a second, independent electronic signature before any batch is released for distribution.
Electronic signatures are bound to the record and display signer, date, time and meaning.
Veltrix MES 7 functional specification, section 12.2, page 88
Separation of duties can be enforced per workflow step through role configuration.
Veltrix MES 7 functional specification, section 12.5, page 93
Failed login attempts lock the account after a configurable threshold and raise a security event.
Steps 1 to 6 derive from the signature workflow described in CAP-018 and CAP-021; the lock-out in step 4 derives from CAP-033.

Please confirm the lock-out threshold with the vendor; the configuration guide says 5 attempts, not 3.
Aoife Doyle · on step 4 · 1 day ago
Agreed. I changed the step to five attempts and flagged the earlier run as failed on that basis.
